description: Inject live free-text steering into a running Strategy Lab optimization, e.g. "stop trying mean-reversion tweaks, focus on trend-following". Applies starting with the NEXT experiment, not the one currently in flight. Overwrites any previously-injected guidance for this run.

guidance.description: Free-text guidance for the AI to apply on the next experiment (max 2000 chars).

jobId.description: Job ID to steer, from start_optimization_run.

name: send_optimization_guidance
